As Victor and Selene's wedding implodes, Athena exposes Selene's lies and alliance with vampires. After a fierce battle, Athena reclaims her honor, restores her legacy, and finds love again with Cassian.
41000116675.title: The Rejected Luna is the Alpha

41000116793.name: The Bad Boy Who Ruined Me
41000116793.synopsis: Hazel Smith, a math prodigy with a quiet life, arrives at LA Tech, determined to succeed. But when she accidentally breaks a luxury watch belonging to Zach Lloyd—the school‘s infamous bad boy and billionaire heir—her life takes a sharp turn. Zach gives her an ultimatum: spend time with him or pay up.
41000116793.title: The Bad Boy Who Ruined Me

41000116844.name: My Online Crush Is My Contract Husband
41000116844.synopsis: A quirky nurse unknowingly falls for her billionaire boss through an anonymous dating app. When fate forces them into a contract marriage to fulfill his grandfather's dying wish, their online crush and real-life tension collide. Between steamy misunderstandings, family drama, and sweet chaos, love may just find its way—on and off the screen.
41000116844.title: My Online Crush Is My Contract Husband

41000117506.name: A Choice That Breaks Us
41000117506.synopsis: Nadia discovers she's pregnant with Renzo's child, but his mafia father forces her to break up with him to save his life. Years later, they reunite under hostile circumstances, with Renzo now engaged to another woman. As secrets unravel—including their daughter's leukemia and Diana's schemes—Renzo learns the truth. After rescuing Nadia and their child from Diana, they reconcile and vow to stay together as a family.
41000117506.title: A Choice That Breaks Us

41000117514.name: The Rejected Alpha Queen Comes Back
41000117514.synopsis: Lucia, the Alpha Queen, returns to her home pack as a wolfless commoner to reunite with her mate, Frederick, only to discover his betrayal. Rejected and tortured, she reveals her true identity and power. With her true mate, Neo, she overthrows Frederick's tyranny, restores justice, and unites the pack under her rule. Love and vengeance intertwine in this tale of redemption and strength.
41000117514.title: The Rejected Alpha Queen Comes Back

41000117875.name: The Mafia's Forbidden Virgin
41000117875.synopsis: After being rescued by Kieran, a mafia heir, from her mother's attempt to sell her virginity, Elena discovers her mother is marrying his father. Now step-siblings, their forbidden attraction intensifies when Kieran becomes her professor, forcing constant contact. From defending her against bullies to simmering home tension, hostility turns into dangerous desire.
41000117875.title: The Mafia's Forbidden Virgin

41000117887.name: Sold As The Alpha King's Breeder
41000117887.synopsis: Rosalie thinks her father sold her to the ruthless future Alpha King Ethan as a maid, but she's actually there to be his breeder. Though she falls for him, she learns he plans to kill her after childbirth. Heartbroken, she escapes with Madalynn’s help, faking her death. Ethan realizes too late she's his mate and searches for her. Rosalie starts a new life, but Ethan finds her, saves her from danger, and slowly earns back her love.
41000117887.title: Sold As The Alpha King's Breeder

41000117903.name: To Be By My Side
41000117903.synopsis: Ten years ago, Aurora Miller waited all night in the rain for a pen pal who never showed—shattering her faith in love. Now, she enters a sudden marriage with an honorable former sailor, Damien Hawke… only to discover he's the very man she once waited for. Fate reunited them—but can trust survive the truth?
41000117903.title: To Be By My Side

41000117996.name: I Kissed A CEO And He Liked It
41000117996.synopsis: Gabrielle Taylor, a bold young model, is publicly humiliated and fired after discovering her ex is marrying her best friend. A spontaneous kiss with powerful CEO Kyle Wright sets off a chain of events that pulls her into his world. Hired as his assistant, Gabrielle must navigate ambition, romance, and betrayal in a glamorous, high-stakes world.
41000117996.title: I Kissed A CEO And He Liked It

41000118236.name: The Professor I'm Dating is A Billionaire
41000118236.synopsis: Reese, a talented student, is humiliated after being cheated on by her boyfriend and losing her internship at WG Group due to the strict professor, Sanger. Unbeknownst to her, Sanger is actually WG's CEO, secretly paving the way for her comeback. Through a high-stakes robot competition, Reese proves herself, wins love, and discovers Sanger's true identity.
41000118236.title: The Professor I'm Dating is A Billionaire

41000118491.name: Dean: My Mafia Protector
41000118491.synopsis: When tailor Megan Shill accidentally kills a mafia heir in self-defense, she seeks protection from Dean Russo—the powerful mafia boss who once promised to keep her safe. As danger closes in, their bond deepens into a fierce romance. But loving Dean means entering a deadly war... and Megan may be the spark that ignites it.
41000118491.title: Dean: My Mafia Protector

41000118506.name: Playing It Real
41000118506.synopsis: To ditch my cheating ex, I kissed a handsome stranger. Turns out, he's not just anyone, but the richest bachelor in town! And now he wants something in return. So we're engaged in a contract marriage. What could possibly go wrong? The only thing is I'm slowly, uncontrollably, falling in love with him.
41000118506.title: Playing It Real

41000118514.name: From Last Pick to First Choice
41000118514.synopsis: Erin Sanders finds herself entangled in a risky romance with her billionaire arch-rival, Nolan Duffy, who covertly becomes her houseboy. But when his deceptions are exposed, threatening her heart and her company, Erin must choose between safeguarding her family legacy or embracing their unconventional love.
41000118514.title: From Last Pick to First Choice

41000118550.name: Escaping the Mafia, I Married A Homeless Billionaire
41000118550.synopsis: To escape a forced marriage to a ruthless mafia heir, broke Uebr driver Myra impulsively claims a scruffy homeless man as her husband—only to discover he's actually the mafia heir himself. As secrets unravel and danger closes in, fake vows spark real feelings in this twist-filled, enemies-to-lovers romance packed with deception, desire, and unexpected redemption.
41000118550.title: Escaping the Mafia, I Married A Homeless Billionaire

41000118580.name: Chasing His Rejected Alpha Wife
41000118580.synopsis: She gave everything as a mate, a Luna, a wife, but when betrayal struck and she was left pregnant and alone, she decided to reclaim her unparalleled true bloodline and be the Alpha they never expected.
41000118580.title: Chasing His Rejected Alpha Wife

41000118844.name: Three Chances, I'm Gone Forever
41000118844.synopsis: After sacrificing everything—her fortune, her health, even a kidney—for her childhood love Erwin, Kama is betrayed and replaced by the manipulative Circe. Vowing to give Erwin just three chances, she rises from heartbreak to reclaim her power, wealth, and dignity—with billionaire Landon by her side. When the final chance is gone, so is Kama's mercy.
41000118844.title: Three Chances, I'm Gone Forever

41000119122.name: Scorned Wife's Revenge
41000119122.synopsis: Jason Wright, a young and capable general manager, is secretly married to Cindy Sully, the mysterious chairwoman of their company. When Cindy visits the office to deliver Jason's forgotten watch, his secretary Nina—who harbors a secret crush on him—mistakes Cindy for Jason's mistress. Fueled by jealousy, Nina humiliates and assaults Cindy, even causing her to miscarry their unborn child. Upon discovering the truth, Jason and Cindy orchestrate a plan to expose Nina's schemes.
41000119122.title: Scorned Wife's Revenge

41000119532.name: Fake Dating My Rich Nemesis
41000119532.synopsis: When a sassy high school girl returns to North Lake High, she doesn't expect to have a one-night mistake with the Beaumont heir, her childhood nemesis, and later team up with him to piss off their exes. Will they eventually fall in love?
41000119532.title: Fake Dating My Rich Nemesis

41000119953.name: Queen Mom Rules
41000119953.synopsis: At her parents' anniversary party, a successful CEO is dismissed as a low-class nobody, her diamond gift is called fake, and she's even banned from the table!
41000119953.title: Queen Mom Rules

41000119996.name: Married to the Secret Lycan King
41000119996.synopsis: A young, wolfless she-wolf's world shatters when she catches her fiancé cheating the night before their wedding. In a twist of fate, she marries a mysterious stranger—unaware he's the powerful Lycan King hiding his identity. As they navigate a marriage of convenience, sizzling chemistry and dangerous pack politics threaten to expose secrets, ignite passions, and change both their lives forever.
41000119996.title: Married to the Secret Lycan King

41000120107.name: Miss You After Goodbye
41000120107.synopsis: To repay a debt of kindness, Neil signs a secret contract with Keira's father stating that he will marry Keira for five years and help her recover from a painful breakup with her first love, Simon. During their contract marriage, Neil is attentive and caring towards Keira, but she never treats him as anything more than Simon's substitute. When the contract comes to an end, Neil discovers Keira's persistent infatuation with Simon and finally decides to divorce her.
41000120107.title: Miss You After Goodbye

41000120429.name: Runaway Bride, Billionaire's Catch
41000120429.synopsis: To escape a forced marriage to the ruthless billionaire heir Frank Reed, Kate Smith bolts from the altar and impulsively weds a man she believes is a poor driver—only to discover he is Frank himself. As secrets unravel and sparks fly under one roof, a runaway bride finds herself in a twist-filled romance of mistaken identity, sweet revenge, and unexpected love.
41000120429.title: Runaway Bride, Billionaire's Catch

41000120484.name: The Way Back Into Love
41000120484.synopsis: After knowing she had cancer and wouldn't have much time left to live, in order not to become a burden to her boyfriend, who booked a big role in Hollywood, she allied with his best friend to play "cheating" and successfully got caught in bed by him. However, she was pregnant and more surprisingly, eight years later, he came back for her, now a superstar...
41000120484.title: The Way Back Into Love

41000120503.name: I Accidentally Slept With My Professor
41000120503.synopsis: Annie never expected her summer fling to become her professor. Their chemistry is electric, their connection is undeniable—but secrets, jealousy, and scandal threaten to tear them apart. As passion blurs the lines between love and ruin, Annie must decide if he's worth risking everything.
41000120503.title: I Accidentally Slept With My Professor

41000120584.name: I Can Hear His Thoughts!
41000120584.synopsis: After saving a mysterious elderly woman's life, Hailey Summers is stunned to discover that she's been gifted a bizarre power — she can hear her boss Ryker's thoughts just by touching him! With this unexpected mind-reading ability, Hailey turns her failing career around and even wins her boss's heart. But when the power is suddenly taken away, will everything still be the same?
41000120584.title: I Can Hear His Thoughts!

41000120886.name: The Lust Game: Seduce Me If You Can
41000120886.synopsis: A virgin signs up for the ultimate seduction show—$5M on the line, no rules but lust. Stuck with her shameless ex, a dangerous lawyer, and a bad boy who knows exactly how to touch her, every task drags her deeper into temptation. To win, she must play with fire... even if it costs her innocence.
41000120886.title: The Lust Game: Seduce Me If You Can

41000121134.name: Divorced, Now a Lycan Princess
41000121134.synopsis: After being cast aside by her powerful Alpha husband and forced to conceal her miraculous pregnancy, a seemingly ordinary human woman discovers she is actually the long-lost Lycan Princess. As her secret identity awakens, she reclaims her power, exposes betrayal, and challenges the ruthless werewolf hierarchy—not just to protect her unborn child, but to decide her own fate.
41000121134.title: Divorced, Now a Lycan Princess

41000121270.name: Ruling Over All I See
41000121270.synopsis: Soon after unemployed graduate Judah Shaw finds himself a penniless scholar in Qirelia, he is forced by the system to win his wives' affection, despite their marriages being purely convenient. To his surprise, among them are a princess, a general's daughter, and a merchant heiress, who bring him not only fortune but also a future brighter than he ever imagined.
41000121270.title: Ruling Over All I See (DUBBED)

41000121351.name: Pucked by My Brother's Rival
41000121351.synopsis: Good girl Jenny's first rule? Never sleep with the enemy -especially not Xavier, her brother Samuel's rival and the league's most insatiable player. But when he catches her mid-fantasy with his nude photo between her thighs, rules shatter faster than the headboard in his bedroom. Facing Xavier's relentless pursuit, the closet, the bathroom, and her exclusive lingerie... Now they're playing a dangerous game of ‘pretend we’re not fucking’—and Samuel is about to find out.
41000121351.title: Pucked by My Brother's Rival

41000121501.name: Move to Countryside, Marry a Billionaire!
41000121501.synopsis: Forced into a marriage to save her adoptive father, Louise Mitchell leaves the city for the countryside, only to discover her "farmer" husband, Troy Scott, is actually a hidden billionaire. Bound by a three-month contract, their rocky start slowly transforms into trust and passion, as schemes, family conflicts, and secrets test their love.
41000121501.title: Move to Countryside, Marry a Billionaire!

41000121776.name: Watch Out, I'm The Lady Boss
41000121776.synopsis: After being cast aside by the man she helped rise to power, Eleanor—secret CEO of the powerful Thunder Circle—is thrust back into the spotlight when a mysterious billionaire proposes marriage, shaking high society to its core.
41000121776.title: Watch Out, I'm The Lady Boss

41000122209.name: Falling for My Fake Dating Coach
41000122209.synopsis: Ashley only wanted to be a quiet secretary. But when she's forced to drag her reckless ex-racer boss, Victor, back into the boardroom, her life turns upside down. He's arrogant, dangerous, and refuses to be tamed—yet he offers her one deal: he'll teach her how to win love, if she keeps his secrets. Every "lesson" blurs the line between business and desire. Every kiss meant as a mistake burns hotter than the last.
41000122209.title: Falling for My Fake Dating Coach

41000122274.name: From Cell to Crown, Lady Kingsley is Back
41000122274.synopsis: After three years in prison for her boyfriend Damien, Harper is freed and learns she's the long-lost heiress of the powerful Kingsley family. Expecting marriage, she instead discovers Damien is engaged to her best friend, and her adoptive father is tormented by loan sharks. With only James—the man whose life she once saved—by her side, Harper claims her identity, gains powerful allies, defeats her enemies, and finds love anew.
41000122274.title: From Cell to Crown, Lady Kingsley is Back

41000122328.name: House Husband? Try Supreme Immortal
41000122328.synopsis: Logan Bale, an immortal who has walked the earth for a thousand years, fulfills a dying promise to his disciple—to protect his family for three years. To honor that vow, he marries his disciple's granddaughter, only to be met with her family's scorn and cruelty. Yet undeterred, he endures their contempt with quiet resolve, holding fast to one promise of his own: to walk away the moment those three years come to an end.
41000122328.title: House Husband? Try Supreme Immortal

41000122380.name: Love, not Lost to Memory
41000122380.synopsis: After giving birth to twins for the powerful Todd family, Vera Bell is drained of her blood in the delivery room to save their chosen heir, Finn Todd—leaving her lifeless, clutching a blood-stained lucky charm. Seven years later, mute and stripped of her memory, Vera survives by scavenging while raising her daughter, Grace Bell.
41000122380.title: Love, not Lost to Memory (DUBBED)

41000122429.name: They Love Me Too Late
41000122429.synopsis: After her family's bankruptcy, Joy was lovingly taken in by the Reynolds brothers until Megan, the maid's daughter, arrived. Megan's scheming framed Joy, turning the brothers against her. Tired of years of mistreatment, Joy left to marry Nathan, a powerful heir, and start a new life. Will the brothers realize the truth before it's too late?
41000122429.title: They Love Me Too Late

41000122433.name: Shelter in the Mafia
41000122433.synopsis: Tasha, betrayed by her husband and her mistress, lost her company and ended up on the streets. A stranger, Ken, a taxi driver, offered her a helping hand. Despite their initial separation, Ken kept reappearing in Tasha's life, leading her into a romantic entanglement. Little did she know, Ken was the son of a mafia boss, on a quest to find a figure from his past.
41000122433.title: Shelter in the Mafia

41000122434.name: Billionaire Playboy's Replacement Bride
41000122434.synopsis: Under her stepmother's pressure, Alicia substitutes her sister to marry a stranger. Disheartened, she finds solace in Lucius's company for a night. Later, at the wedding, she discovers Lucius is the groom, sparking an unexpected love story.
41000122434.title: Billionaire Playboy's Replacement Bride

41000122435.name: Billionaire Daddy: the Hunt Is On!
41000122435.synopsis: Novice mother Miranda works hard to support her son, but always accidentally offends the black-hearted boss Raymond, and this handsome, rich man, who is cold outside and warm inside, is actually the biological father of the child...
41000122435.title: Billionaire Daddy: the Hunt Is On!

41000122437.name: A Heartbeat Away
41000122437.synopsis: Katie heartlessly abandoned her boyfriend Shaun because she looked down on his lack of wealth. Years later, Shaun becomes a young CEO and stands before Katie. He wants her to see her mistake in choosing, but he gradually realizes that the girl before him has actually always loved him.
41000122437.title: A Heartbeat Away

41000122600.name: The Mistaken First Love
41000122600.synopsis: When a proud heiress is forced to marry in her stepsister’s place, she discovers shocking betrayals and vows revenge. But as her bodyguard’s secret identity and their twisted past unravel, love, lies, and fate collide in a storm of passion and deception.
41000122600.title: The Mistaken First Love

41000122689.name: A Deal With My Billionaire Donor
41000122689.synopsis: Claire Miller, desperate to have a child after being diagnosed with premature ovarian failure, vows to get pregnant before her ex’s new girlfriend gives birth. Enter Ethan Reed—a billionaire forced to marry or lose his inheritance. They strike a “sperm contract” for mutual benefit, but when Ethan becomes her new boss, sparks ignite and emotions blur. Can a fake marriage born of pride turn into real love?
41000122689.title: A Deal With My Billionaire Donor

41000122781.name: Cheer Queen Returns To Slay
41000122781.synopsis: A washed-up cheer legend wakes up in her 17-year-old body and infiltrates her daughter's summer cheer camp — ready to protect her bullied daughter, humiliate mean girls, and flip her way back to glory.
41000122781.title: Cheer Queen Returns To Slay

41000122783.name: If Only You Loved Me More
41000122783.synopsis: Five years ago, Alex nearly died saving Beth, who donated her kidney to him, causing her blood cancer. While she sought treatment abroad, Alex's secretary Stella lied that Beth had left him and claimed she was his donor. Betrayed, Alex married Beth out of spite, torturing her until her illness returned. After losing everything, Alex learned Beth was his true savior and the heiress of the wealthiest Duncan family.
41000122783.title: If Only You Loved Me More

41000122809.name: Slay to Fosters: I Took His Uncle
41000122809.synopsis: Caroline Harrington, the only daughter of a top wealthy elite family in LA, concealed her true identity and broke away from her family to marry middle-class CEO Liam Foster. Throughout their marriage, she secretly used her family's resources to support Liam's business. However, Natty Parker, the youngest daughter of the Parker family, had long harbored feelings for Liam. She conspired with Liam's mother to set a trap.
41000122809.title: Slay to Fosters: I Took His Uncle

41000122885.name: The Genius Returns
41000122885.synopsis: They took her in just to treat her like a servant. Her adopted sister kept stealing her math answers, and her family always took the liar's side. So Ada cut ties with them all, right there in the exam hall. But when her solutions kept getting stolen, she did the only thing left—she solved an unsolvable problem in ten minutes. Proof? She just gave it.
41000122885.title: The Genius Returns

41000122896.name: Wild Ride with the Dangerous Kian
41000122896.synopsis: Lydia Gray, a sheltered daughter of a cop, meets Kian Wilder, the dangerously magnetic leader of the Dark Hawks, on her eighteenth birthday. One night of adrenaline and escape changes everything. When Lydia learns that the man she's fallen for is the criminal her father has been hunting, desire and danger collide. The line between love and ruin blurs—can she survive this wild ride?
41000122896.title: Wild Ride with the Dangerous Kian

41000123062.name: Emergency Reckoning: Brother's Fury
41000123062.synopsis: Annie is mistaken for a mistress and is insulted and beaten by her future sister-in-law, Camilla, and her family. Her brother Nolan arrives, calls off his engagement to Camilla, and rescues Annie, leaving Camilla's family full of regret.
41000123062.title: Emergency Reckoning: Brother's Fury

41000123075.name: In Other Words, I Love You
41000123075.synopsis: When Alice scores a scholarship to London's elite Ashford Institute, she clashes with the school's royal pain, Charles "King" Kenward. But one wild twist lands them under the same roof... And their rivalry? About to turn dangerously romantic.
41000123075.title: In Other Words, I Love You

41000123150.name: The Unwanted Wife Strikes Back
41000123150.synopsis: When a housewife discovers her fashion mogul husband is cheating, and stealing her designs, she files for divorce and wages a scorched-earth revenge campaign to reclaim the empire she secretly helped build. But exposing his lies means going to war with his scheming mistress, his icy sister - and allying herself with Cyrus Voss, her husband's biggest rival.
41000123150.title: The Unwanted Wife Strikes Back

41000123213.name: Hero Should Never Stay Low
41000123213.synopsis: A retired war hero hiding as a humble mechanic is dragged back into conflict when he defends a woman from injustice. As his secret past unfolds, he becomes entangled in love, corruption, and revenge—proving that a true hero can never stay low.
41000123213.title: Hero Should Never Stay Low

41000123508.name: Dumped by a Cheater, Spoiled by a Billionaire
41000123508.synopsis: At 8, Nina goes missing and is raised by Bruce's family. After regaining her memories, she learns her real mother died heartbroken. Her mother's will forces her to marry Mark, or her father loses the inheritance. Forced into marriage with a cheating man, Nina seeks proof to escape. Meanwhile, Bruce, who once confessed to her, finds her just before the wedding.
41000123508.title: Dumped by a Cheater, Spoiled by a Billionaire

42000000096.name: Oops! I Mate With My Forbidden Alpha
42000000096.synopsis: Crystal Spear, on the brink of adulthood in a hidden world of werewolves, finds herself torn between the expectations of her pack and the forbidden love she harbors for Theo, her guardian wrapped in mystery and believed to be kin. As secrets unravel and true identities come to light, their love becomes a beacon, challenging the fabric of their world and leading them to fight for a future where they can be together, against all odds.
42000000096.title: Oops! I Mate With My Forbidden Alpha

42000000100.name: Spoil Me Please
42000000100.synopsis: After being jilted, Violet proposes to the first man she sees—who just so happens to be Sean, a former high school classmate who has always loved her. When he says yes, their marriage sets them on an unexpected path to revenge and true love.
42000000100.title: Spoil Me Please

42000000101.name: Wild for My Boy Toy
42000000101.synopsis: In a world where ambition collides with desire, fashion photographer Charlotte Watson learns that love and survival often demand impossible choices. After an impulsive one-night stand with Devin, a captivating model who disrupts her career and her heart, Charlotte finds herself entangled in a stormy love triangle with him and Noam, her loyal yet conflicted boss.
42000000101.title: Wild for My Boy Toy

42000000261.name: Fake Dating The Quarterback on Christmas
42000000261.synopsis: With Christmas right around the corner, a sharp-tongued writer and an egotistical NFL star become reluctant roommates, clashing at every turn—unaware they’re actually each other's beloved online pen pals. Already head-over-heels in digital love, the pair attempt to navigate family, friends, and rivals whilst driving each other crazy in real life this holiday season.
42000000261.title: Fake Dating The Quarterback on Christmas

42000000265.name: Daddy Don't Go, Please Save Mommy
42000000265.synopsis: Seven years ago, Grace sacrificed everything to save the man she loved, and vanished in a car crash while eight months pregnant. Now, her secret little daughter unknowingly draws her back into a world of danger and revenge. This time, their story will end differently.
42000000265.title: Daddy Don't Go, Please Save Mommy

42000000463.name: After I Died He Went Mad
42000000463.synopsis: On their wedding day, Lillian's father killed Sebastian's parents in a drunk-driving crash, turning lovers into enemies. Sebastian had her parents jailed and tortured until they committed suicide, then imprisoned Lillian to make her suffer the same loss. Five years later, she learned she had a week left to live. Unaware, Sebastian kept tormenting her while she treated death as freedom, choosing kindness before ending her life.
42000000463.title: After I Died He Went Mad

42000000481.name: Love You To Death
42000000481.synopsis: Rebelling against her perfect life, high school senior cheerleader Brooke falls into a hot and heavy romance with transfer student and new QB Nate. Everything seems perfect. Until she discovers that Nate has a very dark side.
42000000481.title: Love You To Death

42000000485.name: The Hockey Star Can't Stop Missing Me
42000000485.synopsis: Diana, the coach's daughter who secretly powers her boyfriend Benson's rise, is discarded when his ex returns with a "daughter". Public betrayals from Benson push Diana toward Jake—the man who truly loves her. Amid lies and betrayal, how will she choose?
42000000485.title: The Hockey Star Can't Stop Missing Me

42000000541.name: Through Ashes Their Sorrow Awakens
42000000541.synopsis: Ashley, the Langstons' biological daughter, spends years in prison after Lilith, the adopted daughter, frames her. When she gets out, her whole family—including her fiancé Ethan—still believes Lilith's lies and keeps hurting her. To make Lilith happy, Ethan even agrees to a fake wedding with her. On the day of their wedding, Ashley stages her own death in a fire and leaves for good. That's when they're shocked, panicked, and burning with regret.
42000000541.title: Through Ashes Their Sorrow Awakens

42000000580.name: Badass Heiress Returns
42000000580.synopsis: After a harsh upbringing, Evelyn Vincent returns to her wealthy family, only to find her place taken by Isabella, the adopted daughter she was swapped with at birth. Armed with resilience and a sharp mind, Evelyn navigates a hostile household, confronting her biased mother, hostile brother, and manipulative rival. She fights for her rightful place, from school conflicts to corporate battles.
42000000580.title: Badass Heiress Returns

42000000606.name: His Love Was A Lie
42000000606.synopsis: After two years in a passionless marriage, Charlotte discovers her emotionally distant husband has secretly been in love with his stepsister all along — and she’s just been his cover. So she tells the truth to his stepsister and leaves him, but he ends up regretting it.
42000000606.title: His Love Was A Lie

42000000625.name: Divorce Is My Best Christmas Gift
42000000625.synopsis: Five years ago, law school's brightest star, Hannah, dropped out for love, becoming the perfect wife to Congressman Ethan. This Christmas Eve, her dream wedding turns into a nightmare - Ethan sweeps his first love into his arms and runs. Heartbroken, Hannah returns to campus under Professor Daniel's guidance... Ethan finally realizes Hannah is the one he loves.
42000000625.title: Divorce Is My Best Christmas Gift

42000001099.name: It's Too Late to Apologize
42000001099.synopsis: Her husband accused her of trapping him. Her daughter wished for a different mom. Now she's gone. After one last betrayal, Zoey signs the divorce papers and disappears.What will they do when they realize she's never coming back?
42000001099.title: It's Too Late to Apologize

42000001178.name: Legally Sexy and Mr. Ice Cold
42000001178.synopsis: A one-night stand with billionaire Leo Whitney leaves law student Summer Ellis unexpectedly pregnant. Her toxic sister, Angie, steals Summer's identity and becomes Leo's fiancée. Six years later, Summer crosses paths with Leo again—this time with her five-year-old daughter, Melody. As Summer represents Leo in a custody case, the buried truth resurfaces, and love ignites.
42000001178.title: Legally Sexy and Mr. Ice Cold

42000001185.name: The Legal Queen's Comeback
42000001185.synopsis: Six years ago, after "the Legal Queen" Nora won the rape and murder case, she stepped away from the legal profession for her marriage. However, she returned to the legal world due to her husband Darren's involvement in a major case, exposed Darren's crimes and betrayal, and sent him to prison. With the support of her assistant Ethan, Nora reclaimed the nickname of "the Legal Queen" and took back control of her life, achieving a happy ending in both her career and love life.
42000001185.title: The Legal Queen's Comeback

42000001639.name: Ballerina Reborn For Revenge
42000001639.synopsis: Amelia murders Katherine out of jealousy on her engagement day, then kills herself. The act dooms the sisters to relive their lives from the moment they chose between living with Grandmother or their father Jay—this time forced to remember the tragic fate their past decisions created.
42000001639.title: Ballerina Reborn For Revenge

42000001834.name: Boss, Your Executive Secretary has Resigned
42000001834.synopsis: Anne deeply in love with the Jackson, gives up her position as chief jewelry designer to become his personal secretary and secret lover, until she witnesses the Jackson and his first love Melissa being carried naked into an ambulance after carbon monoxide poisoning. After handling the situation, she decides to resign and return to her career.
42000001834.title: Boss, Your Executive Secretary has Resigned

42000001967.name: Almost Lover
42000001967.synopsis: Evelyn returns from her prenatal checkup to find her husband massaging oil onto his first love's belly. When Evelyn suffers a severe allergic reaction, he locks her in a room and ignores her pain—she loses the baby. Shattered, she walks away and rebuilds at her friend's architecture firm. Months later, Edward finds her at the love-lock bridge where they vowed forever, threatening to jump unless she forgives him. Will Evelyn save the man who destroyed her, or let him fall?
42000001967.title: Almost Lover

42000001987.name: Your Husband is The Tech King
42000001987.synopsis: A humble repairman secretly saves a tech empire—revealed as the vanished Tech King. Betrayed by his girlfriend's greed, he reclaims power and dignity, while a brilliant CEO sees his true worth and becomes his new ally and love.
42000001987.title: Your Husband is The Tech King

42000002385.name: The Last Gambling God
42000002385.synopsis: Legendary gambler Henry Smith is framed by his nemesis and fellow gambler, Lip Orville, and forced into hiding after Lip kills his brother, David. On the run and out of options, he's saved by Sophia and assumes a new identity—Carl, a janitor at an underground casino (a speakeasy officially) in Chicago. But when Lip returns, now allied with the mafia, and the infamous mob boss, Don Bazzini, Carl is dragged back into the dangerous world of gambling.
42000002385.title: The Last Gambling God

42000002416.name: Divorced, Then Find My Mr. Right
42000002416.synopsis: After a brutal betrayal, Hazel loses her marriage, child, and dignity. Rising from despair, she reunites with Evan, a powerful man who helps her reclaim her career, self-worth, and take control of her fate.
42000002416.title: Divorced, Then Find My Mr. Right

42000002456.name: Alpha King's Silent Cinderella
42000002456.synopsis: Saved by a girl who lost her voice for him, Alpha King Evan reunites with Claudia 20 years later—now mute and abused. Bound by fate and lies, he must choose between power, vows, and true love.
42000002456.title: Alpha King's Silent Cinderella

42000002641.name: 3.2.1, Farewell Forever
42000002641.synopsis: Joy, completely disillusioned with her seven-year marriage to Wyatt, wants to leave with their son, Caleb, who has never known his father's love. However, Caleb decides to give his dad three final chances. Will Wyatt be able to seize these opportunities?
42000002641.title: 3.2.1, Farewell Forever

42000003425.name: I Thought You Were Him
42000003425.synopsis: After losing her fiancé, Silas, in a brutal gang war, Mafia princess Stella Moretti is shattered—until she crosses paths with Milo who looks exactly like him. He has no ties to her world, but Stella doesn't care. Desperate to fill the void Silas left behind, she snatches Milo from his life and brings him into hers, determined to keep him by any means necessary.
42000003425.title: I Thought You Were Him

42000003486.name: Kissing the Wrong Brother
42000003486.synopsis: To win the heart of her crush before graduation, nerd Aria enlists the help of his dangerously charming older brother for a crash course in intimacy—only to discover she might be learning how to love the wrong guy. She asks him for lessons in sex and intimacy. And her crush's brother becomes her love coach.
42000003486.title: Kissing the Wrong Brother

42000003510.name: My Poor Husband is the Real Boss
42000003510.synopsis: At a lavish wedding, the bride’s ex drops a bombshell: her billionaire groom is bankrupt, and her family turns on him overnight. What they don’t know—his ruin is a ruse. As a secret hostile takeover ignites, the “penniless” husband strikes back, shattering everyone who mocked him.
42000003510.title: My Poor Husband is the Real Boss

42000003652.name: Your Billionaire Bride Is My Cheating Wife
42000003652.synopsis: On his birthday, low-profile billionaire Anthony discovers his wife is marrying another man—using his identity, money, and status. Crashing the wedding as a “nobody,” he endures public humiliation until the truth erupts: he is the real CEO and Mafia King. As lies unravel, Anthony reclaims his power, exposing betrayal and delivering ruthless revenge.
42000003652.title: Your Billionaire Bride Is My Cheating Wife

42000003785.name: Addicted to Your Kiss
42000003785.synopsis: Ruth Larson's family sells her off to Logan Harlow for money. He icily says that he won't touch her. But when they run into each other at the club, he downs her alcohol in a jealous fit. Ruth asks him to mind himself. But he responds in an aggrieved tone, "Why? Are you scared of others finding out you're married?" This confuses Ruth. Didn't he say they would be divorced in a month? What is he playing at now?
42000003785.title: Addicted to Your Kiss

42000003947.name: A Dangerous Engagement: The Bride He Mustn't Touch
42000003947.synopsis: I ran from the mob at 18. My dad, the mafia king, couldn't find me. And neither could Angelo, my stepbrother, my father's legally adopted son. When my father suddenly died, Angelo found me and brought me back. Though we were never raised together, Angelo saw me as his innocent responsibility. He insisted I marry for my safety and the empire's stability, and took charge of selecting my future husband. But I wanted Angelo to marry me.
42000003947.title: A Dangerous Engagement: The Bride He Mustn't Touch

42000004139.name: Boss, She Said No Again!
42000004139.synopsis: Abandoned for sixteen years, Rowena returns to New York to reclaim her mother's inheritance. Posing as the Kingsley second son's fiancée, she plans a breakup as cover. But she saves Damien Kingsley, the Kingsley's elder son, from a mafia attack. Intrigued, Damien forces into her life. As Rowena navigates traps from her scheming family and ruthless Mrs. Kingsley, her bond with Damien shifts from enemies to allies as they uncover the truth behind a mysterious murder.
42000004139.title: Boss, She Said No Again!

42000004163.name: How to Conquer the Celibate Lawyer
42000004163.synopsis: To save her wrongfully imprisoned mother, Sonja works at a strip club—until a one-night stand with powerful lawyer Bruce Cross leaves her pregnant with twins, and he becomes the man who fiercely protects her from anyone who dares to shame her.
42000004163.title: How to Conquer the Celibate Lawyer

42000004343.name: If I Never Loved You
42000004343.synopsis: Five years ago, Elena sacrificed her heart to mysterious billionaire Victor for a 30 billion investment, saving Nolan's bankrupt family and his life, then lied about being money-driven to break up with him. Five years later, Nolan becomes a tycoon, engaged to Sophia, who actually plotted his family's downfall.
42000004343.title: If I Never Loved You

42000004587.name: Love Will Tear Us Apart
42000004587.synopsis: A deaf bride trapped in a loveless marriage walks away to reclaim her life -- until the husband who broke her finally fights to win her back.
42000004587.title: Love Will Tear Us Apart

42000004631.name: Time To Cut Off My Shameless Family
42000004631.synopsis: After discovering that her "perfect" foster sister Nancy uses a secret power to turn their family against her, Peggy is murdered. But she wakes up ten years in the past—the year her family first adopted Nancy. Now, she must expose the truth and finally break free from her toxic family.
42000004631.title: Time To Cut Off My Shameless Family

42000004809.name: Rescued by the Rugged Mountain Man
42000004809.synopsis: Mia, a city girl who was hurt by her ex, was beaten and banished to a deep mountain covered in ice and snow. In the midst of hunger and cold, she was even attacked by a wild wolf. At this moment, a powerful man saved her. The two started off disliking each other but gradually developed feelings for one another. Mia also discovered the man's true identity and punished her evil ex. Eventually, they lived happily together.
42000004809.title: Rescued by the Rugged Mountain Man

42000005003.name: Engraved On Your Heart
42000005003.synopsis: To save Damien's life, Scarlett broke up with him and raised their daughter alone. Now, because of her terminally ill, she pretends to be the villain again, just to send their daughter back to Damien—until the truth comes out and the family is finally reunited.
42000005003.title: Engraved On Your Heart

42000005230.name: Can't Get Enough of You
42000005230.synopsis: After a one-night stand, Carey is falsely accused of drugging Nolan and is cruelly cast aside. Two years later, she struggles to raise her child alone—until fate brings her face-to-face with her new boss: Nolan himself. Beneath his cold, dismissive exterior, Nolan finds himself drawn to her all over again. But how long will it take before he uncovers the truth—that Carey has been secretly raising his child?
42000005230.title: Can't Get Enough of You

42000005276.name: My Quarterback Ex Is Begging Me Back
42000005276.synopsis: Beth discovers that her husband Evan has another family and that she has been raising his illegitimate daughter for six years. Pregnant, she resolutely leaves him. Evan later clears up the misunderstandings and tries to win Beth back, but it's too late.
42000005276.title: My Quarterback Ex Is Begging Me Back

42000005431.name: For Richer, For Poorer
42000005431.synopsis: When James White, a brilliant aerospace engineer, gives up his career dreams to please his wife, Kelly, he is reduced to working as a humble car washer while enduring years of her resentment and humiliation. Pushed to his breaking point, James walks away from the family he sacrificed everything for, reclaims his identity and rises back to success. When the truth comes out, will Kelly realize what she destroyed before it’s too late?
42000005431.title: For Richer, For Poorer

42000005743.name: Too Late, My Ex-Campus King
42000005743.synopsis: Aria accidentally opens her boyfriend Chase's computer – and what she finds shatters her world: dozens of intimate photos of Chase and his first love, Serena. The discovery becomes the final straw. That very day, Aria agrees to her family's plan – to leave L.A. for New York and take over HMS Group. Unaware of what's brewing in her heart, Chase continues his ambiguous friendship with Serena, blurring every line while convincing himself it's harmless...
42000005743.title: Too Late, My Ex-Campus King

42000005745.name: The Vanished Champ Strikes Back
42000005745.synopsis: An invincible fight king hides his identity, living life as a janitor, but shocking everyone with his true power when confronted with challenges.
42000005745.title: The Vanished Champ Strikes Back

42000005750.name: Call Me Mistress One More Time
42000005750.synopsis: On the day of the wedding, Marcus shares a photograph with his daughter, Isla, on social media. Marcus's fiancée, Vivienne, mistakenly identifies her as his mistress. When Isla approaches Vivienne to present her mother's heirloom necklace, Vivienne initiates a violent assault. Subsequently, Vivienne forcibly takes Isla to the wedding venue, where her entire family converges to reprimand the supposed mistress.
42000005750.title: Call Me Mistress One More Time

42000006333.name: Love and Bloodlust at Vampire Academy
42000006333.synopsis: A human teenage girl, Margo, attends the first-ever integrated boarding school for the wealthy vampire elite and humans. Surrounded by predators, our heroine must learn to survive while also resisting the allure of the captivating vampire prince, Damien.
42000006333.title: Love and Bloodlust at Vampire Academy

42000006665.name: House Husband Supreme
42000006665.synopsis: Silas Lancaster, an immortal who has walked the earth for a thousand years, fulfills a dying promise to his friend—to protect his family for three years. To honor that vow, he marries his friend's granddaughter, only to be met with her family's scorn and cruelty. After the divorce, his true power is revealed, leaving the elite who mocked him begging for redemption.
42000006665.title: House Husband Supreme

42000007126.name: Reborn To Love Alpha King
42000007126.synopsis: Betrayed and reborn, Chelsea Wharton strives to return to her former love and battles wits with malicious relatives who covet her inheritance, changing her fate amidst the dual crises of protecting her love and her legacy.
42000007126.title: Reborn To Love Alpha King

42000007197.name: I Went to the Mafia Boss for a Baby
42000007197.synopsis: I saved a cartel king who tricked me into marriage. What he doesn't know is, I have secrets too.
42000007197.title: I Went to the Mafia Boss for a Baby

42000007205.name: The One That Got Away
42000007205.synopsis: Bella, a prep-school queen, is betrayed when Louis uses her to chase her stepsister Vivian. She transfers to start over—until Louis learns the truth and fights to win her back.
42000007205.title: The One That Got Away

42000007456.name: Goodbye, My Dad's Best Friend
42000007456.synopsis: Lena falls in love with Elijah, her dad’s best friend, who has always kept her at a distance for some reason. Accidentally carrying his child, Lena plans to leave him for good but their tangled love traps her.
42000007456.title: Goodbye, My Dad's Best Friend

42000007571.name: This Letter To You Is My Last
42000007571.synopsis: Ada, diagnosed with a terminal illness, spends the final moments of her life orchestrating a carefully planned farewell. Through it, her husband Frank—who had long despised and humiliated her—finally uncovers the truth that had been hidden from him, only to lose her forever in a sea of endless regret.
42000007571.title: This Letter To You Is My Last

42000007612.name: Oops, I Lied About Sex with My Stepbrother
42000007612.synopsis: A good girl's impulsive lie pulls her into a dangerous, magnetic push-and-pull with the one boy she was never supposed to want—her new stepbrother. Forced under the same roof, their secret games blur the line between pretending and something forbidden. The harder they try to keep control, the deeper they fall into a desire that could ruin them both.
42000007612.title: Oops, I Lied About Sex with My Stepbrother

42000007731.name: Scent of the CEO's Lost Love
42000007731.synopsis: After surviving years of abuse and hiding her identity as the last heir of the Lynn family, blind perfumer Stella is forced into a contract marriage with cold CEO Conor, unaware that she is the girl who once saved his life. As danger closes in, both must confront their shared past, the lies between them, and the growing bond neither expected.
42000007731.title: Scent of the CEO's Lost Love

42000007948.name: Your Loser Husband Is A Big Shot
42000007948.synopsis: Nathan gave up his family empire for love. When his wife and daughter were kidnapped, he chose self-sacrifice and endured three years of torment. Returning home, he found his wife entangled with her former flame and his daughter distant. Heartbroken, he reclaimed his position as heir to the billion-dollar fortune. He severed ties with the past and embarked on a new life.
42000007948.title: Your Loser Husband Is A Big Shot

42000008091.name: Laid Off While Pregnent
42000008091.synopsis: Victoria Wintour, pillar of Maison Levaux, saves the top design company from brink of disaster while 8-month pregnant. However, upon giving birth and returning to office, her new boss Holly terminates her for absent without leave while her protege Rachel claims to be the one who saved the company. In order to keep the rest of the pregnant staff on payroll, Victoria voluntarily leaves with little severance pay.
42000008091.title: Laid Off While Pregnent

42000008092.name: Tempted By My Ex's Professor Daddy
42000008092.synopsis: After getting bullied and cheated on by her boyfriend, Tom, Evelyn sleeps with Nathaniel, an older gentleman who happens to visit the same bar as her. She realizes soon however that Nathaniel turns out to be her new professor and Tom’s father. Will Nathaniel defend Evelyn and will a spark ignite?
42000008092.title: Tempted By My Ex's Professor Daddy

42000008417.name: Weapons! Women! Wild West!
42000008417.synopsis: Joey, a modern-day underdog loser, is suddenly transported into a Wild West game world set during the era of westward expansion and the American Civi War—only to find himself reborn as a penniless cowboy. Forced to accept a main quest titled "Become the King of the Wild Frontier,” he is assigned three female war captives and bound to an affection-based game system.By increasing their favorability, Joey can unlock modern weapons and skills.
42000008417.title: Weapons! Women! Wild West!

42000008760.name: The Day My Stepbrother Knows My Dirty Secret
42000008760.synopsis: I accidentally give my crush’s rival a love letter—then realize it’s actually the porn I wrote. Worse, he turns out to be my new stepbrother- a total devil! Now we’re stuck living under the same roof, he’s holding my embarrassing secret over me… and somehow, we start falling for each other...
42000008760.title: The Day My Stepbrother Knows My Dirty Secret

42000008774.name: Craving My Brother's Best Friend
42000008774.synopsis: After accidentally emailing a steamy fanfiction to her new roommate—who happens to be her brother's best friend—Alison must navigate rising sexual tension and her brother's strict "Bro Code" to get the guy of her dreams.
42000008774.title: Craving My Brother's Best Friend

42000008972.name: Crush Alert! Love Request from My Enemy
42000008972.synopsis: Bullied at her elite school, a scholarship girl shares her secrets only with the mysterious boy she plays online games with. She doesn't know the voice she trusts belongs to her cocky rival at school, who knows the truth and is struggling to tell her.
42000008972.title: Crush Alert! Love Request from My Enemy

42000009318.name: The Sorority Hazed The Wrong Girl
42000009318.synopsis: Equestrian champion and billionaire heiress Laci Richmond arrives at prestigious Salem University ready for a new beginning. But when she's seen with campus king Edward, rumors explode—she’s instantly labeled his mistress. His girlfriend, the ruthless Queen Bee Victoria, is burning with jealousy. Together with her sorority sisters, she vows to make rush weekend a nightmare for Laci. There's just one problem… Laci is Edward's sister.
42000009318.title: The Sorority Hazed The Wrong Girl

42000009374.name: Oops! The CEO's Birthday is Ruined
42000009374.synopsis: Tiffany spoiled her son Billy from birth, never setting limits. He grows into a reckless, entitled brat—wrecking his father's boss's party, humiliating guests, destroying a million-dollar car, and setting it on fire, while she looks the other way. But her blind love comes at a cost: Billy destroys his own future, ruins his father's career, and ultimately sends Tiffany to prison. Only behind bars does she finally understand the price of her love.
42000009374.title: Oops! The CEO's Birthday is Ruined

42000009489.name: Sex Education By My Best Friend
42000009489.synopsis: After a humiliating party, college student Emma turns to her childhood friend Chase, a charming playboy, to help rebuild her confidence. They agree to a simple rule, no kissing, but as they grow closer, feelings begin to develop. When the rule is broken, Emma must choose between the crush she once chased and the love that has been in front of her all along.
42000009489.title: Sex Education By My Best Friend

42000009539.name: Return Of The Gold King
42000009539.synopsis: Secret billionaire Wyatt Stone returns to Silverton for Annie, only to be imprisoned and humiliated by her and her corrupt new partner, Otis Hadley. After being rescued by Annie’s kind sister, Clara, Wyatt learns the Hadleys plan to destroy his old orphanage. At a gala intended for the gold king, the Hadleys plot Wyatt's murder. Instead, he reveals his true identity, ruins his enemies, and finds genuine love by proposing to Clara, saving the town and his past.
42000009539.title: Return Of The Gold King

42000009769.name: Daddy, Love Me One Last Time
42000009769.synopsis: A dying little girl begs to hear her father one last time, but he gives her life-saving kidney to his ex's son instead. After Chloe dies abandoned, her mother, Katherine, unleashes a brutal revenge on the man and mistress who destroyed her child.
42000009769.title: Daddy, Love Me One Last Time

42000009982.name: I Don't Want Any of You Three
42000009982.synopsis: The wealthy heiress Serena Sterling once thought she would marry one of her three childhood friends when she grew up. However, she unexpectedly discovered that all three of them had only been feigning affection for her due to her father's financial support for them, and that their true feelings were actually for the driver's daughter, Bella.
42000009982.title: I Don't Want Any of You Three

42000009996.name: Wait! Our Great-Grandma is 18 Years Old?
42000009996.synopsis: Cryonically revived and posing as a high school girl, 1950s legend Victoria Reed returns to protect her 70-year-old son Andrew and set the next generation straight—until the family learns the 'new girl' is their great-grandmother.
42000009996.title: Wait! Our Great-Grandma is 18 Years Old?

42000010001.name: From Mail-Order Bride To Billionaire's Wife
42000010001.synopsis: Betrayed by her family and boyfriend, Anjelica marries as a mail-order bride to Eric, who appears to be a poor Montana farmer but is actually the CEO of the Hawkins Group. Under Eric's protection, she step-by-step counterattacks those who have hurt her.
42000010001.title: From Mail-Order Bride To Billionaire's Wife

42000010167.name: Faking It with the Hockey Captain
42000010167.synopsis: Scholarship girl Julie has one reckless, electric night with the irresistibly hot new hockey captain—only to discover he's Liam, the childhood enemy she can't stand. To kill rumors and keep their exes away, they fake-date… But the chemistry feels anything but fake, and the tension between them is getting dangerously hard to resist.
42000010167.title: Faking It with the Hockey Captain

42000010438.name: 30 Days to be the Mafia King's Bride
42000010438.synopsis: On Valentine's night, nurse Lydia Hale saves a dying stranger—then learns he's Soren Moretti, a feared mafia king. He offers a brutal ultimatum: marry him or die. Trapped in his dangerous world, desire clashes with defiance. As a 30-day love contract ends, Lydia must choose freedom—or life beside a ruthless mafia king.
42000010438.title: 30 Days to be the Mafia King's Bride

42000010627.name: Kissing the Ruthless Tycoon
42000010627.synopsis: Avera and Liam have been married for eight years. She has supported him all the way to becoming the group president. She always thought their love was unshakable and would never deteriorate. But Liam had an affair with Lilian during their marriage. Avera divorced him based on the loyalty clause in their prenuptial agreement and demanded a $60 million divorce settlement from Mrs. Sterling.
42000010627.title: Kissing the Ruthless Tycoon

42000010641.name: Fated to My Ruthless Alpha
42000010641.synopsis: Seven years after a drugged night left maid Elena wolf-less and pregnant, she regains her wolf only to learn her mate is her cruel oppressor, Alpha Matthew. He cruelly rejects her, trading her to the notoriously savage Alpha Harrison. But Elena soon discovers a divine twist: Harrison isn't a monster. He is her destined second-chance mate and her son Lucas's true biological father—a perfect redemption orchestrated by the Moon Goddess.
42000010641.title: Fated to My Ruthless Alpha

42000010674.name: My Poor Rancher Wife is a Trillionaire
42000010674.synopsis: Forced to marry Sarah West, a poor, sick rancher, Caleb Jameson is stunned to discover Sarah is actually "Lady Gold," a trillionaire seeking true love! With Sarah’s help, Caleb rises to power, leaving his family desperate to win the favor of the very woman they once despised.
42000010674.title: My Poor Rancher Wife is a Trillionaire

42000010883.name: Think Again! I'm the Hidden Boss Mom
42000010883.synopsis: After PTA (Parent Teacher Association) moms target and frame her son, a "nobody" mom is humiliated and cast aside—as an even bigger secret unfolds behind the scenes... until they discover she's the secret billionaire behind the school. Now, she decides their fate.
42000010883.title: Think Again! I'm the Hidden Boss Mom

42000010898.name: Doormat No More: Toxic Ex Lick My Feet
42000010898.synopsis: To save her dying sister, genius engineer Charlotte is forced into a contract marriage with a cold CEO—only to be humiliated for three years. When her powerful ex reappears, she finally has a chance to take back everything… and make them all pay.
42000010898.title: Doormat No More: Toxic Ex Lick My Feet

42000010899.name: Love The Way You Lie
42000010899.synopsis: Framed and betrayed, Molly marries her ex’s billionaire uncle for revenge—only to fall in love. But when her secret is exposed, will their love survive the truth?
42000010899.title: Love The Way You Lie

42000011196.name: Winner's Payback, Rise From Dirt
42000011196.synopsis: Branded a worthless failure and forced to take the fall for her adopted sister, Amelia returns from prison as the Top Winner of the Nobel Maths Competition and cuts off her biological family for good.
42000011196.title: Winner's Payback, Rise From Dirt

42000011262.name: When He Finally Looked Back
42000011262.synopsis: After three years of enduring his wrath as atonement, the terminally ill Lena walks into a fire on his wedding day to end her torment, only to be unexpectedly reborn.
42000011262.title: When He Finally Looked Back

42000011264.name: After Prison, Falling for the Billionaire Single Dad
42000011264.synopsis: Framed by her stepfather after a one-night encounter with the CEO, Grace is imprisoned and separated from her child. She rebuilds her life as a cleaner at the CEO's company, unaware that he is secretly raising the child that she thought was dead. As they grow closer and fall in love, the truth behind her past slowly reveals itself – that the child he's raising was hers!
42000011264.title: After Prison, Falling for the Billionaire Single Dad

42000011904.name: Pregnant by My Professor, Chased by His Son
42000011904.synopsis: "I got pregnant by my professor—and he's my cheating ex-boyfriend's father! " As Iris's ex fights relentlessly to win her back, the professor refuses to step aside. On campus, father and son are locked in a silent battle over the same woman. Where will this forbidden relationship lead, and who will Iris choose?
42000011904.title: Pregnant by My Professor, Chased by His Son

42000012113.name: Torn Between My Stepbrothers
42000012113.synopsis: Hailey has been crushing on Derek for years, only to discover on the day she plans to confess that he is now with her best friend. Heartbroken, she drinks alone and is harassed, but is rescued by Tyler. Mistaking him for Derek, Hailey believes they share a one-night stand—only to wake and realize he is her stepbrother and Derek's older brother.
42000012113.title: Torn Between My Stepbrothers

42000012143.name: Lady Diamond's Lost Heiress Returns
42000012143.synopsis: To save her mother Maria, young Bella Rossi sacrifices herself to the mafia. Twenty years later, Maria has become "Lady Diamond," a powerful mogul searching for her lost child. Meanwhile, Bella is betrayed at her own wedding by her fiancé, Vince, who steals her savings to marry another woman. When Maria recognizes Bella's birthmark while Bella is being humiliated at her wedding, she unleashes her power to protect her daughter and crush their enemies.
42000012143.title: Lady Diamond's Lost Heiress Returns

42000012214.name: I Wish It Were You
42000012214.synopsis: I Wish It Were You is a romantic drama about a fated arranged marriage and a case of mistaken identity that keeps two soulmates apart for far too long. Isabel Scott is a kind, hardworking young woman who enters an arranged marriage with a stranger named Jared Foster at her grandmother's request. On their wedding day, Jared hands her a credit card and leaves immediately for Italy on business, leaving Isabel heartbroken and confused. She never expects to see him again.
42000012214.title: I Wish It Were You

42000012856.name: Roommate Benefits: The Governor's Son
42000012856.synopsis: Megan hid her heiress identity for love, only to be betrayed by the boyfriend she gave everything to. After their breakup, she unexpectedly ends up living under the same roof as Cole Warner—the governor's sexy, rebellious badboy son. What starts as constant clashes soon turns into an irresistible attraction neither of them can escape.
42000012856.title: Roommate Benefits: The Governor's Son

42000012863.name: My Brother's Wrath Awaits
42000012863.synopsis: After surviving an abusive mafia father, Aurora spends her life calming her volatile brother Lucian, now the city's most feared mafia boss, who violently punishes anyone who disturbs her peace. When Lucian's iancée mistakes Aurora for a maid and tortures her, Lucian is manipulated into hurting Aurora. As Aurora disappearsinto the underground black market, Lucian uncovers the devastating truth and unleashes his wrath on everyone responsible - even himself.
42000012863.title: My Brother's Wrath Awaits

42000012972.name: Cause You Were Never Mine
42000012972.synopsis: Jade fakes an affair with Dexter, to shield her boyfriend Bruce from her mother’s medical crisis just as he is about to propose, Heartbroken and betrayed, Bruce leaves. Five years later, he returns as the powerful CEO of Morgan Group and hires Jade. It sparks a roller coaster of deep resentment and undeniable chemistry, leading them through a painful but beautiful journey back to love.
42000012972.title: Cause You Were Never Mine

42000013146.name: Divorced at the Wedding Day
42000013146.synopsis: On Lorenzo’s engagement day, his fiancée Sophie mistakes his pregnant sister Alessia for his mistress, publicly abuses her with her entire family, causes her miscarriage, and destroys a five-billion-dollar family heirloom necklace. After the truth is revealed, Lorenzo launches a bloody revenge for his sister, while Sophie’s fake pregnancy and betrayal scheme are exposed.
42000013146.title: Divorced at the Wedding Day

42000013481.name: Silence! Boss Lady Speaks
42000013481.synopsis: Eleanor, a reclusive heiress returning from Africa, is mistaken for a penniless charity worker and publicly humiliated by her ex and his family. But when a mysterious CEO, Sebastian, sees something rare in her and proposes marriage, their union sends shockwaves through high society. As her enemies push too far, Eleanor fights back—revealing her true identity as Thunder Lady, the secret CEO of the world’s most powerful investment syndicate.
42000013481.title: Silence! Boss Lady Speaks

42000013483.name: Revenge Puck
42000013483.synopsis: Lucy has just been cheated on and dumped by her ex-boyfriend and hockey star Adam. She makes a deal to fake date his biggest hockey rival, Blake, to throw off his game until the end of the playoffs.
42000013483.title: Revenge Puck

42000014005.name: Bucked by My Father's Cowboy
42000014005.synopsis: Shy horse girl, Jessa Fey, promises her father, the bull-riding coach, that she will stay away from his most unruly cowboy, Hart Bronson. But Hart's irresistible charm breaks down her defenses and threatens to get them both into trouble.
42000014005.title: Bucked by My Father's Cowboy

42000014119.name: Bullies and Me
42000014119.synopsis: On the first day Chloe transfers to Blackstone Academy, she confronts the Hayes brothers—the privileged nobles here. She is labeled "untouchable" and is stuck with the bullying brothers. They become each other's biggest enemies. However, after a series of bullying incidents, Archer develops romantic feelings for Chloe. Will she return those feelings?
42000014119.title: Bullies and Me

42000014541.name: Don't Regret When She Let Go
42000014541.synopsis: Bella spends two years pursuing Louis, only to find out he gets close to her to get to her stepsister. Heartbroken, she decides to walk away. Too late, Louis figures out he has fallen for the wrong girl—and regret is eating him alive.
42000014541.title: Don't Regret When She Let Go

42000014568.name: Bound by a Devil
42000014568.synopsis: Alicia was brutally abused and murdered by her husband. At of death's door, she was saved by Preston, a cold and powerful demon. To exact revenge, she made a pact with him, trading her soul in exchange for immense power. Preston helped her seize all of the Rory family's assets and dismantle their vast business empire. Yet amid her quest for vengeance, she gradually fell — deeply in love with this demon.
42000014568.title: Bound by a Devil

42000014893.name: Fear Her, My Mom's the Lady Boss!
42000014893.synopsis: Claire suffers constant abuse from her fiancé and his family, never knowing that her mother, whom she believes is only a janitor, is actually Lady Thunder—the legendary founder of a trillion-dollar empire. When her daughter is pushed to the brink, Lady Thunder returns from hiding to crush her enemies, expose impostors, and reclaim her throne. But when a fake heiress steals Claire's identity, an explosive battle for power, family, and revenge begins.
42000014893.title: Fear Her, My Mom's the Lady Boss!

42000015264.name: No Escape as the Dragon King's Mate
42000015264.synopsis: On a rainy Valentine's night, Lydia, a human nurse, saves a bleeding stranger, only to discover he's Soren—the ruthless Dragon King. His ultimatum is brutal: become his fated mate or die. Dragged into a lethal supernatural world, Lydia finds her defiance melting into burning desire as she glimpses the vulnerable heart beneath the tyrant's scales. With the 30-day contract ending, will she claim her freedom, or surrender to the Dragon King forever?
42000015264.title: No Escape as the Dragon King's Mate

42000015277.name: Vampire Elite: The World Between Us
42000015277.synopsis: A human girl who lost her parents to vampires must attend a vampire-elite school to save her brother, only to become the unexpected obsession of pureblood vampire prince Caleb Salvatore—a forbidden romance that will either save her or destroy them both.
42000015277.title: Vampire Elite: The World Between Us

42000015527.name: Submitting to My Bestie's Dad
42000015527.synopsis: What's worse than having your nudes leaked by an ex? Falling for the dark, dangerous man who rescued you—who also happens to be your best friend's dad. June knows every step into Killian's sanctuary is a betrayal, yet she deliberately tests his legendary restraint with whispered provocations. In the heat of his study, morality vanishes. As they play a high-stakes game of don't get caught,' gratitude blurs into obsession, threatening to explode before graduation.
42000015527.title: Submitting to My Bestie's Dad

42000015757.name: Guess Who They Miss Now
42000015757.synopsis: Samantha, the high school basketball team manager, is framed and killed. Reborn at the moment when suspicion first arose, Samantha makes a different choice: she leaves the basketball team and joins the ice hockey team, where she finally discovers her own worth. Only then does the basketball team realize how indispensable she was—but by then, it is far too late.
42000015757.title: Guess Who They Miss Now

42000016034.name: Doting Snake Lord
42000016034.synopsis: Reborn before her tragic fate unfolds, Elena gets a second chance at life. In her previous life, she was betrayed by her sister Veronica and fiancé Grayson, framed for infidelity, and pushed into the Dragon Pit to her death. Determined to change her destiny, Elena turns to Nidhogg, the imprisoned Dragon Progenitor, and unexpectedly becomes pregnant with his nine heirs.
42000016034.title: Doting Snake Lord

42000016711.name: Princess Returns to Sea Without You
42000016711.synopsis: To marry the mortal she saved, Marina, daughter of the Sea God, forfeited her divinity. Yet his cold betrayal pushes her to sever their bond and reclaim her throne. Now, as her powers awaken, the remorseful husband begs for mercy—but she won't give him a second chance to break her heart.
42000016711.title: Princess Returns to Sea Without You

42000017124.name: No Mercy From My Cowboy Daddy
42000017124.synopsis: Sydney flees to her boyfriend Billy's ranch after a fight with her father, only to discover Billy's betrayal. There, she becomes entangled with his enigmatic father, Ryder, a powerful businessman with secrets of his own. As Sydney navigates danger from a scheming rival and her manipulative father, she uncovers a hidden world of crime and deception. Amid mistrust and growing attraction, Ryder protects her, leading to truth, redemption, and an unexpected future together.
42000017124.title: No Mercy From My Cowboy Daddy

42000017218.name: 404 Error: You Lost My Love
42000017218.synopsis: For five years, Hugo gave up his dream career to care for his sick wife, Sheila. But while he devoted his life to her, she humiliated him, ignored him, and chose her wealthy ex over her husband. Heartbroken, Hugo files for divorce and leaves on a dangerous deep-sea mission. Only after he's gone does Sheila realize she lost the one man who truly loved her. But when she finally wants him back... will she be too late?
42000017218.title: 404 Error: You Lost My Love

42000017312.name: The complete transformation of a girl
42000017312.synopsis: Rookie lingerie designer Grace Miller sneaks into Chris Sullivan's company to earn money for her seriously ill sister's surgery, but is mistaken for an erotic experience tester. After a series of mix‑ups, she ends up signing a BDSM training contract. All she ever wanted was to be taken seriously as a designer, yet her creations are mocked as "devoid of desire.
42000017312.title: The complete transformation of a girl

42000017580.name: Breaking: Your Ex-Wife Is a Billionaire Heiress
42000017580.synopsis: Victoria, a billionaire heiress, gives up everything to marry Ethan, only to be disowned and endure 33 failed IVF attempts before finally becoming pregnant. When Ethan wrongly believes the baby belongs to another man, he abandons her during a devastating accident to save his first love instead. Only after their divorce does he realize he destroyed the woman who sacrificed everything for him.
42000017580.title: Breaking: Your Ex-Wife Is a Billionaire Heiress

42000017739.name: Still You Always You
42000017739.synopsis: As an adopted sister, Laila had one night with her brother Jason accidentally and got pregnant. She left home upon finding he had a girlfriend...8 years later, she becomes Vanessa, a respectable leading scientist, not the helpless girl any more, and she has a daughter. For business cause, she meets Jason again, who believes his sister died and can't recognize for her new name and look. However, he smells similarities and will not let her go..
42000017739.title: Still You Always You

42000017882.name: Step Back! I'm the Hidden King
42000017882.synopsis: On a New York-bound flight, Arthur meets Throne Tech heiress Anya, who offers a fake marriage to escape an arranged union. Arthur refuses, yet upgrades her investment bid to $100 billion. Later dumped by his fiancée Serena, Arthur is defended by Anya. At a grand gala, Arthur reveals himself as Titan Group's CEO. He funds Anya, and the two choose to build a new life together.
42000017882.title: Step Back! I'm the Hidden King

42000018529.name: Tempest：The Last Mecha
42000018529.synopsis: Broken by his parents' deaths, Colt Thorne, the Mech King, hides as a lowly janitor after being saved by Freya. But when Freya, the woman he secretly loves, is betrayed and forced into a lethal mech duel, Colt must unleash his hidden identity. Unlocking his legendary 100% Neural Sync, he commands The Tempest to crush his enemies and save the world from an extinction-level alien swarm!
42000018529.title: Tempest：The Last Mecha

42000019058.name: Keeping Secrets with the Rowing Captain
42000019058.synopsis: Nerdy virgin, Olive, cuts a secret deal with the campus rowing champ, Brad, to learn about sex and seduction in exchange for biology tutoring, in order to win over his teammate and her sexually-experienced crush Zeke. But when practicing intimacy turns into real feelings, she wonders if she's choosing the right rower.
42000019058.title: Keeping Secrets with the Rowing Captain

42000019210.name: Heartbreak High: Revenge on My First Love
42000019210.synopsis: Golden-boy Brody gives his girlfriend, Alexis, a promise ring, excited for her to finally meet his older sister, Becca, at the prom. But when Alexis mistakes Becca for Brody's mistress, she and her clique brutally humiliate her in the ballroom. After Brody reveals the truth, Becca rises to demand justice, turning the prom into a reckoning where every bully, accomplice, and bystander must pay.
42000019210.title: Heartbreak High: Revenge on My First Love

42000019777.name: Definitely Not The Dragon God
42000019777.synopsis: Aris has spent his life as an academy's lowest servant, cursed with blood that makes every dragon fear him. But when a drop of that blood hatches a legendary dragon egg, his life is turned upside down. Hunted by powerful enemies and burdened with a destiny he never asked for, Aris must uncover the truth before the world does.
42000019777.title: Definitely Not The Dragon God

42000020710.name: Love Me When I Am Gone
42000020710.synopsis: To pay her father's medical bills, Rosie marries Mason in place of her runaway twin sister for a three-year contract. Just as her devotion finally wins his affection, his first love returns, shattering her world. Enduring neglect and heartbreak, Rosie leaves him without looking back the moment the three years are up. By the time Mason learns the truth and regrets his actions, she is already gone.
42000020710.title: Love Me When I Am Gone

42000021162.name: It Was Always You
42000021162.synopsis: Chloe Green divorces her indifferent rich husband, Liam Green, after a three-year contract marriage. But then she discovers she is pregnant and herself the long-lost heiress of the extremely wealthy Miller family with six elder brothers. As Chloe embraces her new life, her suddenly jealous ex-husband starts chasing her, a fake Miller heiress refuses to give up her spotlight and chaos follows at every turn. Love and family have never been so complicated—or so much fun.
42000021162.title: It Was Always You

42000021382.name: Deny Me, Dragon King
42000021382.synopsis: Human Lyra stumbles on Dragon King Kael and shares a passionate night. Tricked by a fake prophecy, he casts her out—only for Lyra to bear his half-dragon daughter Amber. Years later, she returns seeking a healer to save her sick child. Old sparks reignite, jealous rivals plot, and hidden blood ties surface as they fight for their family and broken love.
42000021382.title: Deny Me, Dragon King

42000021675.name: Tempted by My Brother's Mafia Rival
42000021675.synopsis: When sheltered virgin Mia Franco transfers to Santa Lucia Academy, her brother forbids her from getting romantically involved with rival heir Dante DiMarco, but she secretly falls for him, leading to escalating desire, defiance of her family, and a feud between her brother and her lover, Dante.
42000021675.title: Tempted by My Brother's Mafia Rival

42000021679.name: Stitched Hearts to the Billionaire’s Late Regret
42000021679.synopsis: Years ago, Ava secretly sacrificed everything to save her sick lover, Ethan, and pretended to be a gold digger to force him home for treatment. Five years later, their son Noah died saving Ethan's grandmother. Humiliated by Ethan's fiancée while Ethan remained blind to the truth, Ava finally revealed everything. Ethan deeply regretted his actions, but Ava refused to forgive him.
42000021679.title: Stitched Hearts to the Billionaire’s Late Regret

42000021680.name: Hooking A CEO Daddy for Mommy
42000021680.synopsis: Julian Morgan, a cold billionaire heir, is forced to produce an heir—but the only woman he ever wanted disappeared after a one-night stand. Then a boy appears... with his face. "Be my son. I'll pay you." "Deal. But my mom can't know." A perfect secret—until Julian meets the boy's mother working in his factory... and realizes she's the woman he's been searching for.
42000021680.title: Hooking A CEO Daddy for Mommy

42000021919.name: Shifter Academy: Taming Three Wild Mates
42000021919.synopsis: What could possibly go wrong when a human girl spends mating season at a school full of apex predators? Everything. Ivy only wanted to finish her education. Instead, her scholarship to Shifter Academy comes with a catch: she's the fated mate of not one, not two, but three of the strongest shifters on campus: Ronan, Leon and Talon. Three alphas. One impossible choice. Her heart has chosen. It's love at first slap.
42000021919.title: Shifter Academy: Taming Three Wild Mates

42000022499.name: A Dare to Kiss My Bad Boy
42000022499.synopsis: Avery Parker transfers to elite Crestwood School hoping to reunite with her childhood crush, Nathan. Instead, a humiliating accident makes her the target of campus gossip and brings her into constant conflict with Jaxson Hale, the school's notorious bad boy. As bullying, secrets, and rivalries unravel, Avery discovers Nathan isn't who she imagined, while Jax's unexpected loyalty challenges everything she believes about love, trust, and second chances.
42000022499.title: A Dare to Kiss My Bad Boy

42000023322.name: Bridal Revenge Served Cold
42000023322.synopsis: After CEO Luca quickly gets engaged to his billionaire investor Minka, his family, led by his greedy sister Camilla, mistakes her for a mistress. They end up humiliating and abusing her at the rehearsal dinner, trying to protect the money they think they're about to get, until the truth comes out and everything turns into revenge.
42000023322.title: Bridal Revenge Served Cold

42000023486.name: Nanny to the Mafia Single Daddy
42000023486.synopsis: Mafia godfather Victor closes his heart off to love after the unexpected death of his wife. But when Jennifer, his daughter's nanny, enters his life, he finds himself losing control and giving in to feelings he never expected. As their passionate push-and-pull romance unfolds, the two must overcome misunderstandings and survive brushes with death before finally finding their way to each other.
42000023486.title: Nanny to the Mafia Single Daddy

42000023802.name: He Broke the Heart That Saved Him
42000023802.synopsis: Mia sacrifices everything for her dying lover Vance, never knowing he is Cloud City's greatest heir. To return the future to him, Mia walks away resolutely without telling him she's pregnant. Years later, their child's tragic fate crosses their paths again. Yet vicious lies turn him against her, driving their boy to his death. Since then, Mia has lived in the pain of losing her son, while Vance, upon discovering the truth, will be left to bear the crushing weight of regret.
42000023802.title: He Broke the Heart That Saved Him

42000024002.name: My Ex's Brother Teaches Me to Puck
42000024002.synopsis: When med student Lily gets dumped for being "the most unfuckable girl on campus," she teams up with her ex’s brother, Mason Clark, to learn the art of "sex appeal." However, as their lessons draw them closer emotionally as well as physically, Lily realizes Mason was the one all along. But when her ex discovers she’s moved on, the rivalry between the brothers explodes. Will the brothers be able to mend their bond and Lily be with Mason? Or will her ex tear them apart?
42000024002.title: My Ex's Brother Teaches Me to Puck

42000024788.name: Wet Hot Summer with the Boy I Lost
42000024788.synopsis: On the last day of school, Skye bets her biggest bully she'll lose her virginity to the hottest guy, Luke, over the summer. But shy Skye has never even been kissed. When her irresistibly hot neighbor Grayson offers to teach her how to win Luke over, sparks fly between them instead. Soon, Skye realizes the one guy she swore she'd never want is the one she can't resist.
42000024788.title: Wet Hot Summer with the Boy I Lost

42000025226.name: Poisoned by His Love
42000025226.synopsis: On her half-sister Victoria's wedding day, 25-year-old nurse Lily Watson is forced into a deadly bargain. Victoria is set to marry Dominic Castellano, a ruthless mafia king rumored to have killed his last wife. But when Victoria flees, Dominic's hitmen threaten Lily's family. To protect them, Lily takes Victoria's place at the altar and becomes the bride of a man she fears may be a killer.
42000025226.title: Poisoned by His Love

42000025240.name: Kneel Before The Dragon Queen
42000025240.synopsis: After seven years in hiding, Dragon Queen Veya returns disguised as a humble healer, only to be betrayed and humiliated by the man she once loved. When she enters a marriage of convenience with powerful Duke Kael Frostwing, her enemies mistake her for a powerless commoner—until Veya reveals her true identity and reclaims her throne.
42000025240.title: Kneel Before The Dragon Queen

42000025978.name: Forbidden Fling With My Bestie's Dad
42000025978.synopsis: After catching her fiancé cheating on the flight to her best friend's tropical wedding, grad student Mia drunkenly hooks up with Damien, a mysterious silver-fox billionaire, only to discover he's the bride's father. Forced to hide their forbidden attraction throughout a chaotic wedding weekend, they face jealous exes, secret encounters, and vengeful sabotage that could destroy the ceremony.
42000025978.title: Forbidden Fling With My Bestie's Dad

42000026689.name: Sorry, No Dragon Heiress Here
42000026689.synopsis: Sera is the lowest servant at a dragon riders' academy—a girl whose blood is so tainted that no dragon would ever choose her. But when that same "poison" blood hatches the legendary Sovereign dragon egg, the powerless maid becomes the most dangerous woman in the realm. Now hunted by the very lords who once spat on her, Sera must claim a destiny written in blood—and make every enemy who wronged her pay.
42000026689.title: Sorry, No Dragon Heiress Here

42000027479.name: Never Mess With The Undercover Queen Bee
42000027479.synopsis: At St. Martin's High, the wealthy students have a sick game called the Charity Case Roulette-they randomly pick a broke girl as their prey, chasing her for a month to make her fall in love, only to publicly dump and humiliate her. The new charity case, Audrey, is chosen by the school's King Lucas as his latest target. However, what no one knows is that Audrey is actually the sole heiress to the elite Martin Group and the true Chair of the school board.
42000027479.title: Never Mess With The Undercover Queen Bee
